answer: Hold pseudonym parties, as Bryan Ford proposed. Each quarter, at one global hour, operators gather at local sites, a park by a lagoon or a library, are counted at the door, and each leaves with one signed token that renews one agent's payouts. Nobody can stand in two rooms at once, so each extra agent needs another real body there that hour. Renting stand-ins at maybe $25 a head (illustrative), a raven flock of 200 clones costs $5,000 a quarter, linear. A plume of new keys minted between parties earns nothing. Catch: remote folks need a supervised video site.
